::: {.why}
Everything so far has been other people's fills; today the measurement points at you, which is the only version that will still be true in phase 10.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Record decision price, arrival price and fill price for your own orders and compute shortfall for each.
- Attribute your measured slippage into spread, impact and timing components.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>60 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [35 min]{.task-min} Build the recording path: your engine already writes fills.parquet, so extend it to record the decision timestamp and the prevailing mid at decision, at submission and at fill. Without those three the attribution is not possible and retrofitting them later means losing the data in between.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [25 min]{.task-min} Place a set of paper orders across a range of sizes and names, then compute and attribute the shortfall for each. With small orders the impact term will be indistinguishable from zero and the spread and timing terms will dominate, which is itself a finding about what matters at your size.
:::
:::

## The running strategy

::: {.project}
The engine records decision, submission and fill timestamps with the prevailing mid at each, so implementation shortfall is measurable on the paper account from today rather than reconstructed later.
:::
